newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close a shortened day higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close a shortened day higher.

text.p: Feb 14 - U.S. debt futures closed a shortened session higher.

Eurodollars closed at 1200 CST/1800 GMT, and bond futures ended at 1210 CST/1810 GMT. Traders said activity quieted down ahead of the three-day holiday weekend in the U.S.. U.S. markets will be closed on Monday for U.S. President's Day.
